en: In the 1930s, a new mathematician appeared in France: Nicolas Bourbaki.
zh: 1930 年代，法国出现了一位新数学家：尼古拉·布尔巴基。

en: His books helped change how math was written, for decades.
zh: 他的书在几十年里，帮助改变了数学的写法。

en: Bourbaki was a group of young French mathematicians.
zh: 布尔巴基是一群年轻的法国数学家。

en: They wrote together and signed one name.
zh: 他们一起写作，署同一个名字。

en: Members were expected to leave at 50.
zh: 成员到 50 岁就要退出。

en: So the author never grew old.
zh: 所以这位作者永远不会变老。

en: Ralph Boas wrote that Bourbaki was a pseudonym.
zh: 拉尔夫·博厄斯写道，布尔巴基只是个化名。

en: Bourbaki replied that Boas was the fake: just an acronym.
zh: 布尔巴基回信说，假的是博厄斯：那只是个缩写。
他们的成果至今随处可见。

en: Even the empty set symbol comes from them.
zh: 连空集符号都来自他们。

en: This week, OpenAI released 722 math papers.
tts: This week, Open A I released 722 math papers.
zh: 这周，OpenAI 发布了 722 篇数学论文。

en: Their author has no name either: an unreleased internal model.
zh: 它们的作者同样没有名字：一个未公开的内部模型。

en: Bourbaki was many people behind one name.
zh: 布尔巴基是很多人藏在一个名字后面。

en: This time it is one model behind hundreds of papers.
zh: 这一次，是一个模型站在几百篇论文后面。
